description: With include-unsupported-proxy: a node whose supported map is false for every Tier 1 platform, http with headers, h2-connect, ss over TLS without a plugin, naive, vless Reality without public-key, and vless xhttp stream-one with download-settings. The option lifts the support map, root headers, Shadowsocks over TLS and the admission filter, not the Reality and stream-one rules.
